1. (Currently amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit, __wherein said trigger bit is embedded within a data field of said send packet__, and triggering an event in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit __wherein said event is triggered by detecting a transition of said trigger bit within said data field__.

2. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __initiated by detection of said trigger bit transition__.

4. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and wherein said receive packet is transmitted synchronously with said trigger bit receipt__.

5. (Currently amended) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement __wherein said results are acquired at a timing determined by said trigger bit detection__.

11. (Currently amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __embedded within a data field of said send packet__, and means in each said module for triggering a module specific event upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits __wherein said event is triggered by detecting a transition of said trigger bit within said data field__.

12. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises __synchronous__ waveform digitization __initiated by detection of said trigger bit transition__.

14. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and wherein said receive packet is transmitted synchronously with said trigger bit receipt__.

15. (Currently amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement __wherein said results are acquired at a timing determined by said trigger bit detection__.

16. (Original)
